conceptual_statement: Pennsylvania’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is HICPA search-only home-improvement registration plus separate asbestos/lead and public-work debarment layers, a PA PUC intrastate Household Goods universe that is not FMCSA, DOH facility licensing with 1,202 exact state→CMS bridges while PCH/ALR remain search-only, 2025 HMDA county-market activity that is not an NMLS census, PID licensed-company NAIC identities with complaint/enforcement/exam/insolvency catalogs while agency/producer bulk remains search-only, and IAPD state-IA/ERA/notice/principal-office lenses that cannot collapse into one adviser total. Organizations and evidence records stay separate. Missing, restricted, and search-only sources are unknown — not zero.

intelligence_strip.grain: Distinct DLI CERT IDs. Supporting: 299 asbestos contractor rows / 4,985 people; 155 lead contractor rows / 943 people; 6 current prevailing-wage debarment listing rows. HICPA statewide census is OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY. Pennsylvania has no universal general-contractor license.

Active Household Goods Operators list. Supporting: 269 active list rows; 266 distinct Carrier IDs; 537 insurance observations; 1,923 docket rows. PUC intrastate authority is not FMCSA interstate authority.

647 nursing-home + 403 Home Health + 152 Hospice exact CCN bridges. Supporting: 659 DOH nursing-home rows; 659 Home Health; 4,656 Home Care; 178 Hospice. Classes are separate. PCH/ALR current rosters remain OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY.
Canonical county-market grain: 271,254 originations / 80,570 denials / 67 counties. Not lenders. Current NMLS company, broker, servicer, and MLO rosters remain OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY.

PID Licensed Company Search A–Z. Supporting: 595 2025 complaint comparison rows / 9,209 complaints; 3,232 Enforcement Actions documents. Company ≠ agency ≠ producer. Agency and producer bulk remain OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY.

IAPD APPROVED state IA. Supporting: 99 state ERA, 3,411 notice filings, 623 principal-office overlay. Do not add these populations. Principal office is not registration. Notice filing is not state IA. ERA is not an RIA.

what_makes_pennsylvania_different: Contractor: Pennsylvania has no universal statewide general-contractor license. HICPA home-improvement registration is search-only and is not a competence finding. Asbestos, lead, and public-work debarment are separate grains.
Move: PA PUC publishes a real intrastate Household Goods authority universe distinct from federal FMCSA. Utility Code is not automatically Carrier ID. A docket is not an adverse finding.
Senior: DOH facility licensing has meaningful exact state↔CMS bridges, while PCH/ALR remain separate DHS systems and current rosters are search-only. Home Care is not Home Health.
Lender: Strong 2025 HMDA market activity plus DoBS/NMLS search paths and PHFA program context, but no fake combined lenders census. NMLS current rosters remain search-only.

Insurance: Strong PID legal-insurer census, complaint comparison, enforcement, exams, and insolvency catalogs; agency/producer bulk remains search-only. Property and Allied Lines is not homeowners. SQA-009 product intent is preserved.
Investor: Strong IAPD jurisdiction lenses, but state registration, ERA, notice filing, and headquarters are separate regulatory concepts. Mixed DoBS documents are not an IA disciplinary census.

contractor.grain_note: HICPA registration ≠ general-contractor license. Specialty CERT ≠ HICPA. Firm ≠ person. Debarment ≠ complaint. Search-only ≠ zero. Municipal licensing ≠ state licensing.

move.grain_note: Utility Code ≠ automatically Carrier ID. Carrier ≠ broker. Authority row ≠ unique mover. Office address ≠ service territory. Insurance evidence ≠ authority. Docket ≠ adverse finding. PA PUC ≠ FMCSA. Carrier ID ≠ MC.

senior.grain_note: PCH ≠ ALR ≠ nursing home. Home Care ≠ Home Health ≠ Hospice. LIFE/PACE ≠ facility license class. State Facility ID ≠ CMS CCN unless source-published. 659 NH = 659 Home Health is coincidence. Sanction ≠ inspection ≠ complaint.

lender.grain_note: Canonical HMDA scalar is county-market 444,887, not LEI-cell 441,180. Application ≠ lender. LEI ≠ NMLS. Open Data supporting rows ≠ NMLS census. MLO ≠ lender. Broker ≠ lender ≠ servicer. CFPB complaint ≠ finding. PHFA ≠ DoBS license. FDIC bank ≠ non-bank licensee.

insurance.grain_note: Legal insurer ≠ group. Insurer ≠ agency ≠ producer. NAIC ≠ NPN. Surplus lines ≠ admitted census. Company power ≠ consumer product. Property and Allied Lines ≠ homeowners. Complaint ≠ violation. PID Complaint Index ≠ Trust Score. Market-conduct ≠ financial exam ≠ enforcement. Liquidation ≠ rehabilitation ≠ discharge.

investor.grain_note: State IA ≠ SEC RIA ≠ ERA ≠ notice filing. Principal office ≠ registration. IAR person ≠ adviser firm. Broker-dealer ≠ investment adviser. Mixed DoBS catalog ≠ IA disciplinary census. Document ≠ unique matter.
